results.question: How do I improve contrast and spacing in Canva?

sources.title: Add and edit text - Canva Help Center
sources.quote: Select the text. On the toolbar, select Advanced Settings . Under Spacing , adjust the line spacing and letter spacing sliders.

2. On the toolbar, select Text color.
3. Choose a color to apply to your text.

results.question: How do I group elements in Canva?

sources.title: Group, layer, and align elements - Canva Help Centre
sources.quote: Keyboard shortcut: After selecting the elements, press Command + G (Mac) or Ctrl + G (Windows) to group them.

sources.title: Group, layer, and align elements - Canva Help Center
sources.quote: Keyboard shortcut: After selecting the elements, press Command + G (Mac) or Ctrl + G (Windows) to group them.

sources.title: Move elements in your design - Canva Help Center
sources.quote: group, choose one element to remove, then tap Ungroup .

sources.title: Group, layer, and align elements - Canva Help Centre
sources.quote: You can’t group content created by third-party apps from the Apps tab with other elements in your design. To make it groupable, right-click the content, select Download selection, and save it as a PNG or JPG. Re-upload the file to Canva and add it to your design. It will behave like a regular image that you can group with other elements.

results.text:
1. Select multiple elements on the canvas.
2. Press Command + G (Mac) or Ctrl + G (Windows) to group the selected elements.
3. To ungroup, select the grouped element and click 'Ungroup' in the toolbar or use the context menu.
4. For third-party app content, download it as PNG/JPG, re-upload, then group as a regular image.
5. Verify grouping by attempting to move elements together as a single unit.

results.question: How do I add a frame in Canva?

sources.title: Use frames and crop images into a shape - Canva Help Center
sources.quote:
1. From the editor side panel, select Elements.
2. Under Browse categories, select Frames.
3. In the Search elements field, describe what you're looking for. Press Enter.
4. Under Search results, select a frame to add it to your design.

sources.title: Use frames and crop images into a shape - Canva Help Center
sources.quote: Add the image or video you want to fit into the shape.
